## General Blazing Donut Glaze

A wonderfully ridiculous *name-drop*, not a pony we actually see: Rainbow Dash confidently invents “General Blazing Donut Glaze” while failing a Wonderbolts-history quiz in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Twilight's intended answer is **General Firefly**, the Pegasus who named the Wonderbolts. The name is spoken in the TV episode, but the supposed general is not established as a real historical character. [Dialogue transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Testing_Testing_1%2C_2%2C_3).

- **Look:** No verified on-screen design, coat, mane, or cutie mark. The question describes the correct answer as a famous *female Pegasus*; that is not evidence of Blazing Donut Glaze's appearance.
- **Naming:** “General Blazing Donut Glaze” is the full joke name spoken by Rainbow Dash, not a documented alias for General Firefly or Donut Joe. No earlier or official alternative name was verified.
- **Voice and appearances:** *Mentioned only*, in **S4E21, “Testing Testing 1, 2, 3”** (April 5, 2014); no independent dialogue or credited voice actor. **Ashleigh Ball** voices Rainbow Dash, who says the name. [Episode cast](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt3099884/fullcredits/) · [Release listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/testing-testing-123/umc.cmc.2lqzpcz6l4oibcrzaiwlrux1m?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j).

## Important moments

1. **The breakfast-themed wrong answer — “Testing Testing 1, 2, 3” (S4E21).** Asked who named the Wonderbolts, Rainbow confidently answers “General Blazing Donut Glaze”; Twilight reveals that all three quiz answers were wrong. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ySMSgyYt-iU) (*scene timestamp unavailable*).
2. **Rainbow learns the true history — “Testing Testing 1, 2, 3” (S4E21).** After her friends turn the lesson into a flying experience, Rainbow correctly recalls **General Firefly**, putting her breakfast-inspired guess in context. [Official full episode, alternate upload](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mssrtg-O9T4) (*scene timestamp unavailable*).

*Only one mention of this named figure is verified; these are two connected scenes in Rainbow Dash's story, not two appearances by the general.*
